In this article, we explore how to build a simple but powerful Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system using NeuronAI and Ollama.
Whether you're building an AI assistant that can search your documentation or a bot that provides grounded answers based on custom content, this guide will walk you through the key concepts and implementation steps.

Adapt early. Design globally.
